text: Unlike Siskin-9, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Ibis-4 is the Cairo datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Ibis-4 applies to Siskin-9, the datacenter differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Wren-6 is implemented in Swift; the language was chosen for its tooling.

Godwit-7 has one owner, the Tessera team, which approves each release and keeps the runbook current.

Unlike Siskin-9, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Godwit-7 is 4000 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Godwit-7 applies to Siskin-9, the rate limit differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Source for Godwit-7 is written in Elixir; no other language is allowed in its repository.

The yearly budget for Godwit-7 is $110k, covering licences and hosting. An older draft of this note was archived.
